features.description: Intake Agent extracts structured fields from uploaded document using Pydantic schema
Single agent: receives document, extracts fields, retrieves relevant regulation, returns first-pass answer
Orchestrating Compliance Agent calls retrieval, reasons over evidence, produces flagged issues list
Deterministic validation layer checks agent output against rules (not another LLM call)
Custom MCP server exposes regulation lookup tool
Custom MCP server exposes mock account/transaction lookup tool
Custom MCP server exposes internal policy rulebook query tool
Agent calls all three MCP tools correctly during a real run (not hardcoded function calls)
features.note: 2026-10-13: 'not hardcoded function calls' means the calls go through a real MCP client session over stdio, not direct Python calls. Which tools are called, in what order, and with what arguments is hardcoded in compliance.judge_price_and_value_with_mcp_context; the model only reads the results and never chooses a tool. This method is called only by tests, not by the evaluated pipeline. Agentic tool use (model-chosen tools) is a separate, later feature: see docs/agent_tool_use_design.md.

features.phase: Phase 5: MCP tools layer (additional scope, not in original plan)
features.description: Agentic tool use: the model chooses which MCP tools to call, and with what arguments, inside a bounded loop (8 calls, search_regulation 4 with one per outcome, other tools 3, 6 turns) and submits an assessment citing numbered evidence
features.note: 2026-10-24 live: claude-sonnet-5 chose its own MCP tools in 72 runs (v2 19x3, v1 15x1), 0 failures, 0 limit stops. Required calls made 100% (regulation 54/54 with one search per outcome, account 45/45 with the correct customer number, policy 48/48). 10 unnecessary calls in 6 runs (v2_d17, v2_d18). See docs/eval_results_v2.md and docs/eval_agent_v2_report.md.

features.phase: Phase 5: MCP tools layer (additional scope, not in original plan)
features.description: Deterministic checks on every agent run (no LLM): required and unnecessary tool calls, quotes found in the passage they name, citations only from the agent's own searches, policy quotes in the policy passage, escalation criteria 2.1(a)-(c) checked against account facts; failures force insufficient_evidence and give review reasons
features.note: 2026-10-24: ran on every live agent run (862 checks logged in the v2 runs 1-2 audit run alone). Escalation: 50/57 correct; the 7 errors are held-out cannot_determine cases.

features.phase: Phase 8: Evaluation (additional scope, not in original plan)
features.description: Confidence calibration report per outcome category: whether any category could skip review, with the 95% bound and the documents needed
features.note: 2026-10-20: src/evaluation/calibration.py (zero API cost) wrote docs/eval_calibration_eval_raw_main_pass_v2.md from the full baseline pass. Gates: one run with confidence >= 0.65; all 3 runs compliant; both. Unit = document. Exact Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on the missed-issue rate of approved compliant verdicts. Result: no category qualifies at a 1%, 2% or 5% target under any gate. 0 missed issues were seen, but at most 13 approvals per category gives bounds of 20.6% or more. With 0 missed, a gate needs 299 / 149 / 59 approved documents for 1% / 2% / 5%. Auto-approval stays off. Tests: tests/test_calibration.py (3).
